resources.string: Dontry Shopping Assistant helps you virtually try on clothing while shopping on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Meesho. This service is used ONLY to detect when you open a clothing product page, show a floating try-on button, and take a screenshot of the product when you tap the try-on button. This service does NOT read, collect or store passwords, payment information, or any personal data.
Detects clothing product pages on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Meesho to show virtual try-on button
